questions: Are your product images generated using AI?

Some lifestyle and styled images are generated or enhanced using AI, using photographs of our actual handmade products as references. AI helps illustrate different settings and use cases, such as gifting, styling or hanging a product; it is not how the physical product is made. These images are illustrative and may not reproduce every stitch, colour or proportion exactly. People, backgrounds and props in styled scenes are not necessarily real or included with your order. Please refer to the selected product's description, materials, dimensions and What's included details rather than judging size from a styled scene. Handmade pieces can have small variations, and screen colours can differ. If you would like to see an actual product photograph or clarify a detail before ordering, ask us on WhatsApp.
How do I place an order?

Choose the product and variant, add your items to the cart, and save your contact and delivery address. Review your coupon, shipping and total, then pay securely through Razorpay. Your online order is confirmed after payment verification; you do not need to confirm it again on WhatsApp. Guest ordering is available; email signup is optional. Saved delivery details stay with your cart for up to 30 days and are visible to Luvia for order fulfilment. Use WhatsApp for help or assisted ordering if online checkout is unavailable. Adding items or sending a message does not confirm an order.
Can I request different colours or customisation?
Ask us on WhatsApp with the product link and your preferences. Options depend on the product; we will confirm whether the request is possible, along with any price or timing changes.
Do you ship across India, and how much does shipping cost?

We ship across India. For online checkout, shipping is free when the items subtotal after coupon discounts is at least ₹500. Below ₹500, the current saved courier estimate rounded up to the next ₹10 applies, or ₹100 if no current estimate is available. Review the shipping charge and total before you pay. Delivery time after dispatch depends on your location.
When will my order be dispatched?

Orders are dispatched within 5 days of receiving the order, or earlier. Dispatch means handing the parcel to the courier. Delivery time after dispatch depends on the destination and is not included in this dispatch window.
How do I pay?

Use Proceed to payment after reviewing your delivery address, coupon, shipping and total. Razorpay processes the payment, and your online order is confirmed after payment verification. If online checkout is unavailable, contact Luvia for assisted ordering and confirm payment instructions before sending money. Never share your card PIN, OTP or passwords in a message.
Does this website take payment or complete checkout?

Yes. Online checkout uses Razorpay, and your order is confirmed after payment verification. You do not need to confirm a paid online order on WhatsApp. Adding items to a cart or sending a message does not take payment or confirm an order. If online checkout is unavailable, contact Luvia for assisted ordering.
Are shipping charges included in the displayed price?

Prices are in Indian rupees. Shipping charges, if applicable, are shown before payment. Confirm the selected variant, quantity and final total including shipping before paying. Variant prices can differ; the price shown for your selected variant applies.
What materials and sizes are used?
Check the individual product details for confirmed materials and dimensions. Information varies by product; ask us to confirm any missing details, suitability or sizing before ordering.
How should I care for my crochet product?
Follow the care instructions on the individual product page where provided. If instructions are missing or you are unsure, contact us before washing; care depends on the materials and construction.
